verdict.rationale: Kong's AI Gateway documents MCP-related capabilities—traffic governance, security, observability, and cataloging of MCP servers alongside APIs/agents (kong-gh-6, kong-docs-3, kong-docs-22, kong-docs-40)—implying it can front and route to MCP servers. However, the concrete evidence leans toward Kong auto-generating/exposing its own MCP servers from REST APIs (kong-docs-53, kong-docs-54) rather than a clear, documented workflow for a user to plug in arbitrary third-party MCP servers so Kong itself consumes their tools. Missing for 10: explicit step-by-step docs for registering external MCP servers as consumable tool sources, and independent/hands-on confirmation that Kong actually invokes external MCP tools rather than just governing/cataloging them.
